title: CloudEvents
snippet: CloudEvents is a specification for describing event data in common formats to provide interoperability across services, platforms and systems. CloudEvents is a Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) specification that simplifies interoperability by providing a common event schema for publishing and consuming cloud-based events.
claim: CloudEvents is a CNCF specification providing a common event envelope format for cross-platform interoperability.

title: A2A Protocol
snippet: The Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocol was introduced by Google as a standard for direct communication between autonomous agents across organizations and systems. Its main goal is to enable agents to communicate, collaborate, and delegate tasks securely without human intervention or ad-hoc integration code.
claim: A2A Protocol enables agents to securely communicate and delegate tasks across organizations without ad-hoc integration.

title: Why CloudEvents for A2A Communication?
snippet: CloudEvents provides a standardized format for describing event data, enabling interoperability and flexibility in agent communication systems. The standard CloudEvents attributes (type, source, subject, time) provide essential metadata about the event itself, independent of the payload, which is invaluable for routing, filtering, auditing, and debugging event streams.
claim: CloudEvents provides standardized metadata for A2A communication, enabling routing, filtering, and auditing.

title: Event-Driven Architecture (EDA): A Complete Introduction
snippet: Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) is an architectural approach where systems communicate through events. An event represents the fact that something has happened within the system, such as a payment being made, an order being placed, or new data entering the system.
claim: Event-driven architecture enables work intake systems to communicate asynchronously through event producers and consumers.

title: spec/cloudevents/spec.md at main · cloudevents/spec
snippet: Every CloudEvent conforming to this specification MUST include context attributes, and compliant CloudEvents implementations that support those encodings MUST adhere to the encoding rules specified in the respective event format. Producers MUST ensure that source + id is unique for each distinct event.
claim: CloudEvents conformance requires context attributes and unique source+id pairs for producers.

title: Procurement Intake & Orchestration: The Complete Guide (2026)
snippet: Intake & Orchestration systems act as a system of engagement that route different request types to different systems intelligently. Modern design focuses on automated orchestration, where the system coordinates procurement workflows with specific risk assessment triggers.
claim: Modern intake systems use intelligent routing and automated orchestration to coordinate distributed workflows.
